## The everyday decision

How useful is the available evidence when considering a receiver matchup?

## The evidence

The source files pair previous-week inputs with later outcomes. That
relationship, the input season and availability times must be checked before
making a comparison. The original 2025 Week 8 matchup analysis is excluded:
its defense file duplicates the prior week's file. Missing slot/wide inputs
will not be reconstructed.

## Status

Published analyses will explain their cutoff, exclusions and exact code
revision.
